summary.text: Kathleen Cates is a Democratic state representative from District 44 who has represented the district since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the New Mexico House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A realtor and former nonprofit executive, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that water conservation is among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: As of 2022, Kathleen Cates lived in Rio Rancho, New Mexico, and her career experience includes working as a nonprofit CEO, realtor and small business owner.
She volunteered as a member of the New Mexico Developmental Disabilities Council.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she was an executive and advocate for people with disabilities for more than 20 years and managed a supportive housing program in her nonprofit career.
Cates took office on January 1, 2023, and for 2025-2026 is assigned to the Health and Human Services Committee and the Agriculture, Acequias and Water Resources Committee, where she is vice chair.

In the survey she said she carries bills to remove obstacles for working families and small businesses and that water conservation and agricultural communities are priorities, and she listed inclusion and accessibility and health care among her key campaign messages.
